cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: At 500' MSL, when directed by Tower, contact Corpus Departure (UHF CH 8):

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, {to.area.checkin}.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules {to.area.checkin}.

cards.note: The binder gives no check-in phrase for Mustang Central; it is assumed to follow the North/South pattern. Check with an instructor.
